major_cooldowns.name: Shadow Dance
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Enter Shadow Dance with low or finishing combo points only when Secret Technique is ready, then spend the window on Stealth-empowered casts.

major_cooldowns.name: Shadow Blades
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire Shadow Blades alongside Shadow Dance so its doubled combo-point generation and 20 percent shadow echo land inside your burst window.

major_cooldowns.name: Secret Technique
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Spend Secret Technique as your top finisher as early as possible inside Shadow Dance, since every other cooldown is aligned to it.

major_cooldowns.name: Goremaw's Bite
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast Goremaw's Bite on cooldown whenever your combo-point deficit is 3 or more to refill resources heading into a burst window.

major_cooldowns.name: Vanish
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use Vanish offensively on cooldown at low combo points to gain another Stealth-empowered Shadowstrike.

defensives.name: Cloak of Shadows
defensives.usage_rule: Pop Cloak of Shadows to shrug off incoming magic damage or clear a harmful magic effect.

defensives.name: Evasion
defensives.usage_rule: Use Evasion ahead of heavy physical or ranged melee damage to double your dodge chance.

defensives.name: Crimson Vial
defensives.usage_rule: Press Crimson Vial early and often as a low-cost self-heal to top yourself off between damage spikes.

rules.description: Fire Secret Technique inside Shadow Dance
rules.action: Only enter Shadow Dance when Secret Technique is ready, then cast Secret Technique inside the window; the second Shadow Dance during Shadow Blades is the exception.

rules.description: Pair Shadow Blades with Shadow Dance
rules.action: Cast Shadow Blades only when Shadow Dance is ready so both burst cooldowns stack in the same window.

rules.description: Delay burst cooldowns for Shadow Blades
rules.action: When Shadow Blades is about to come off cooldown, hold Shadow Dance and Secret Technique a few seconds so they line up with it.
Open every pull with Shadowstrike from Stealth, then chain into Shadow Dance, Shadow Blades, and Secret Technique.
Keep the target within auto-attack range at all times so Shadow Techniques keeps feeding you energy and combo points.

rules.description: Never Shadow Dance during a global cooldown
rules.action: Trigger Shadow Dance only when off the global cooldown and follow it instantly with your next cast so Deepening Shadows lets you fit an extra global.

rules.description: Swap to Black Powder at three or more targets
rules.action: Replace Eviscerate with Black Powder as your finisher once three or more targets are present, and build with Shuriken Storm.

source_summary: Subtlety concentrates nearly all of its damage into stacked cooldown windows anchored on Secret Technique: Shadow Dance is used only when Secret Technique is ready, and Shadow Blades is paired into the same window with a second Shadow Dance following inside it. When Shadow Blades is about to return, Shadow Dance and Secret Technique are delayed slightly to keep them aligned. Stay in auto-attack range for Shadow Techniques income, avoid triggering Shadow Dance during a global cooldown, and swap finishers to Black Powder in AoE.
